messages:
liam_infra: Heads-up — after the overnight driver/CUDA push to nodes in eu-central-1 (NVIDIA driver 543 + CUDA 12.3 images) we're seeing multi-GPU jobs failing during model init. First surfacing in the TRT/flash-attn workloads. dmesg shows repeated 'ptx compilation failed' and 'unresolved symbol' on H100 pods.

maya_ml: Noted. Which fleet/instance type? H100, A100? Any NCCL errors?

liam_infra: Primarily H100c. NCCL shows 'unhandled system error' during ncclCommInitRank on 2+ GPU jobs. Single-GPU runs usually succeed but performance drops because FlashAttention falls back to a slower kernel.

alex_sre: Can you paste the relevant logs? Even a short snippet helps.

liam_infra: Sure — sample from pod (trimmed):
```
[  +0.000123] flash_attn: register kernel 'flash_attn_fwd' failed: ptx compile error: ptx version 9.1 not supported by current runtime
[  +0.000046] turing: unresolved extern '__device_function' in module 'libtactics.so'
[  +0.002100] NCCL WARN Call to ncclCommInitRank returned unhandled system error
```

sara_eng: That looks like a PTX/toolchain mismatch — newer nvcc/PTX embedded by TRT plugins vs. runtime driver. Was the library set recompiled or did the driver bump?

liam_infra: Driver bump + bundled CUDA container images were updated as part of the scheduled infra maintenance. The container images include a rebuilt TRT + flash-attn build (we rolled that last week). The only change today was node driver and kernel modules.

josh_platform: Impact summary: ~18% of H100 capacity in eu-central-1 is returning jobs with errors; fallbacks cause 3-5x latency for some inference endpoints. A handful of Dedicated customers saw higher P95 and some timeouts. Cost is increasing because autoscaler spins extra nodes when jobs retry.

maya_ml: Quick check: can we spin a canary H100 node with the previous driver (542) and run the failing job? If it passes that's a solid rollback vector.

liam_infra: I spun a canary with driver 542 and the same image — job passed and used native FlashAttention kernels, NCCL init ok. So regression introduced by 543 driver (or kernel module).

deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: nodepool=eu-central-1-canary-h100-rollback, image=runtime:2026-03-18, driver=542.

alex_sre: Plan: 1) Pause further 543 rollouts in other regions. 2) Roll back eu-central-1 to driver 542 for H100 pool (maintain A100 for now). 3) Add a triage job to build TRT/flash-attn against 543 drivers in staging to reproduce with verbose PTX logs. 4) Communicate to customers impacted.

sara_eng: Also recommend we add an automated canary gate: after any driver bump, run a short set of ML kernels (TRT/flash-attn/xformers) on 3 instance types before rolling past 10% of fleet.

josh_platform: Agree. Also flagging capacity implications: rollback requires draining nodes which will reduce available H100 slots during the operation. We should schedule a controlled rollback window and increase transient burst capacity in us-west-2 to lease extra A100 to absorb load (cost impact estimated +$12k/day while rollback ongoing).

liam_infra: Starting rollback now for eu-central-1 H100 pool. I'll post updates.

oncall-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-041 — eu-central-1 H100 driver regression. Owner: liam_infra. Priority: P1.

maya_ml: For immediate customer mitigation, we can re-route latency-sensitive endpoints in eu-central-1 to Dedicated capacity in other regions for affected customers who opted in. Ops, can you help identify which tenants to move?

josh_platform: I'll run tenant-impact script and return list in 15m. Also opening a billing hold for customers moved during the incident so we can reconcile cost.

alex_sre: Next steps assigned: liam_infra rolling back driver + health checks; maya_ml will run repro with verbose PTX compile in staging; sara_eng will draft postmortem checklist and gating policy; josh_platform will handle tenant routing and cost tracking.

liam_infra: Rollback complete on the H100 pool. Health checks green after reboots; NCCL and flash-attn kernels load properly on verification jobs. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours.

sara_eng: Thanks — please add the kernel module symbols/ptx logs to the incident ticket for offline analysis. We'll coordinate with NVIDIA/TensorRT upstream if needed. :pray:
